001package bank.auth;
002
003import bank.model.Customer;
004import bank.persistence.DataRepository;
005
006/**
007 * ============================================================================
008 *  AuthService.java
009 *  Owner   : Abdul Rahman Fornah (afornah1@umbc.edu)
010 *  Helped by: Jordon Tang        (jtang10@umbc.edu)
011 * ============================================================================
012 *
013 *  ROLE:
014 *      Acts as the authentication gateway for the banking application. It 
015 *      handles user login, session management (tracking the current user), 
016 *      and account unlocking services.
017 *
018 *  LOGIC:
019 *      - Uses DataRepository to fetch customer information.
020 *      - Delegates PIN verification to the Customer model.
021 *      - Persists state changes (like failed attempts) back to the repository.
022 * ============================================================================
023 */
024public class AuthService {
025
026    private final DataRepository repository;
027    private Customer currentUser;
028
029    /**
030     * Initializes the AuthService with a reference to the data repository.
031     * 
032     * @param repository The repository used for customer data access.
033     */
034    public AuthService(DataRepository repository) {
035        this.repository = repository;
036    }
037
038    /**
039     * Authenticates a user based on their ID and PIN.
040     *
041     * @param customerId The ID of the customer attempting to log in.
042     * @param pin The plaintext PIN provided.
043     * @return The authenticated Customer object on success; null if login fails.
044     */
045    public Customer login(String customerId, String pin) {
046        Customer customer = repository.findCustomer(customerId);
047        
048        if (customer == null) {
049            return null; // Customer not found
050        }
051        
052        if (customer.isLocked()) {
053            return null; // Account is locked due to too many failed attempts
054        }
055        
056        if (customer.verifyPin(pin)) {
057            this.currentUser = customer;
058            repository.save(); // Persist the reset of failed attempts
059            return customer;
060        }
061        
062        // PIN was incorrect; Customer.verifyPin already updated failed attempts/lock status.
063        repository.save(); // Persist the incremented failed attempt counter or lock status
064        return null;
065    }
066
067    /**
068     * Logs out the current user by clearing the session.
069     */
070    public void logout() {
071        this.currentUser = null;
072    }
073
074    public Customer getCurrentUser() {
075        return currentUser;
076    }
077
078    /**
079     * Administrative function to unlock a locked customer account.
080     *
081     * @param customerId The ID of the customer to unlock.
082     * @return true if the customer was found and unlocked; false otherwise.
083     */
084    public boolean unlock(String customerId) {
085        Customer customer = repository.findCustomer(customerId);
086        if (customer == null) {
087            return false;
088        }
089        
090        customer.unlock();
091        repository.save();
092        return true;
093    }
094}
